statement: Reproduces CORT Table 3. Records numerically optimized continuous four/five-beam research plans, a feasible four-beam 10-MU-grid incumbent, and a five-beam synthetic global-gain-robust plan. All three-beam subsets are numerically infeasible under v1. No clinical or novelty claim.
status: Local author-checked pilot; featured launch not recommended for this exact benchmark
scope: Original CORT TG119 synthetic phantom, pinned matrices and config/research.json. Compare table rows only at identical case, beam budget, quantum and gain model. Quantized incumbent is not proven optimal.

assumptions.statement: Original QIB influence model is accepted as a computational benchmark only; physical accuracy and actual delivery are unvalidated.
Independent reviewer and medical-physics interpretation review are outstanding.

reproduce_full: See README.md and docs/report.md for optimizer and trial regeneration commands.
prerequisites: Python virtual environment with requirements.lock binary wheels; original pinned data included
